text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: A practical derivative limits the gain applied to high-frequency measurement noise

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Ideal derivative is evaluated analytically; practical derivative uses a first-order filter and zero initial filter state. Small high-frequency noise
becomes large under differentiation. The filtered path has bounded high-frequency gain K_d/τ_f. Derivative on measurement can avoid setpoint kick; units
